name: Liquid Glass
description: Bright, refractive glass layers floating over vivid color, with soft depth and pill shapes
descriptionZh: 明亮通透的玻璃层悬浮在鲜艳色彩之上，柔和纵深与胶囊圆角
author: core

variables.--font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Inter', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Noto Sans SC', sans-serif

keyProperties.explanation: Saturated blur lets the colors underneath bleed through like liquid
keyProperties.explanationZh: 高饱和模糊让下层色彩透出，形成液态折射感

keyProperties.explanation: A bright rim mimics light catching the glass edge
keyProperties.explanationZh: 亮边模拟玻璃边缘的高光

keyProperties.explanation: Large radii and pill buttons keep forms soft
keyProperties.explanationZh: 大圆角与胶囊形按钮，形体柔和
